verdict.rationale: Sentry maintains official SDKs across many platforms (Python, Rust, Unity, Unreal, Godot and more), with step-by-step install guides, and community users report integration was simple. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official client SDK for the Sentry management/web API as opposed to instrumentation SDKs, and thin evidence on per-language SDK documentation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Sentry SDKs ... Python ... Rust ... Unity ... Unreal Engine ... Godot Engine
